sources.label: Morphe patches for AARE (Android Auto replacement): integrated Shizuku (no Shizu
sources.author: AARE
patch_list: The voice button opens AARE's own assistant on the car screen, in Italian, German or English: navigation, music, messages and replies, calls, the time. For anything else it opens the phone's assistant (Google).

Declares the background location permission, so that after choosing "Allow all the time" for AARE in the system settings, navigation apps keep GPS with the phone locked even when AARE starts the car connection in the background.
Dictated replies and AARE's assistant listen through the car's microphone (the phone's if the car has none). Android 13 or newer.

AARE starts its own Shizuku through wireless debugging, without the Shizuku app: pair once from Settings, and AARE starts it again by itself after a restart and when the car connects, on any Wi-Fi including the car's.
Adds "Settings" to AARE's settings home: one switch with a short description for each installed patch. New releases of the patches add their switches there by themselves.
With the car's GPS used for the phone, the position keeps moving in tunnels: it is estimated from the car's speed, compass and gyroscope until the GPS is back.

Plays WhatsApp voice messages in the car when a message is read aloud, instead of reading "Voice message (0:05)". Reads them through Shizuku, which AARE already uses for car audio, so AARE needs no storage permission.
